category_intent: Add these products to the existing camera skins category.
primary_image_rule: Each product uses its own *-01-cover.webp as its main card image and first gallery image. The two-standing-phones-on-white Dragon sample is a composition reference, not one shared image for all products.
gallery_rule: Use the explicit image positions; one product per product folder.

compression.dimensions: Original dimensions preserved; no resizing, cropping, recoloring or regeneration.
